_note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or CLI entry points. It defines hyperparameters and data pipelines for ImVoxelNet 3D object detection on ScanNet with NeRF-based RGB rendering.
configure_imvoxelnet_model: configure the ImVoxelNet model with ResNet50 backbone, FPN neck, and ScanNetImVoxelHeadV2 for 3D object detection
configure_nerf_rendering: configure NeRF rendering in image mode with 64 samples per ray and 20 sample views for RGB supervision
configure_scannet_dataset: configure the ScanNetMultiViewDataset with 18 indoor object classes and multi-view image loading pipeline
configure_training_pipeline: configure the training pipeline with AdamW optimizer, step LR schedule, and 12 total epochs
configure_input_modality: configure input modality to use images, depth maps, and ray data for NeRF-based 3D detection
